data.rationale: The proposal captures the core of opening an event, selecting a ticket count and clicking Book Now/Reserve Now, but it omits the city selection and the navigation to Special Events. It also uses vague parameters (event, time) instead of city, date and ticket count, so an automation couldn't be built from it without guessing.
